scope: Reconcile the exact stale legacy session cancellation and terminal-clear rules without a transition or runtime action.

sourceRules.cancel: App cancelSelectedProjectProposal accepts only previewed or approved sessions and persists cancelDesktopProjectProposalSession.
sourceRules.clear: App clearSelectedTerminalProjectProposal accepts only terminal status; clearTerminalDesktopProjectProposalSession rereads the exact session and removes only its storage key.
sourceRules.resetRoute: The exact test-only reset route loads only the fixed project ID, requires previewed, cancels, requires cancelled, clears, then rereads MISSING before PASS; its terminal message states no recovery apply.

conclusion: A future bounded session-only reset may cancel the exact stale preview then clear its terminal record; it cannot approve, apply, recover, create a primary, or alter protected fixture content.
